comments.author: @s.a.8618
comments.text:
Iranians rarely use cash; instead, they pay for everything by card, not VISA or MasterCard, but cards issued by local banks. 
One rather unusual usage of these cards is that people tell the shopkeeper their password loudly, with no fear of being robbed by someone who can use their cards. 
Carrying a load of cash as presented here is totally wrong, not even close to reality. Besides Iranian currency is not like the Venezuelan currency that necessitates carrying a cartload of cash.
